ruleDefinitions.name: Transferring Files with Credential Data via Network Shares
ruleDefinitions.description: Transferring files with well-known filenames (sensitive files with credential data) using network shares Note: Unmapped fields: RelativeTargetName

sequences.query: (event_id = 5145 AND ((RelativeTargetName = RGX(".*\\\\mimidrv.*") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX(".*\\\\lsass.*") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX(".*\\\\windows\\\\minidump\\\\.*") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX(".*\\\\hiberfil.*") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX(".*\\\\sqldmpr.*")) OR (RelativeTargetName = "Windows\\NTDS\\ntds\.dit" OR RelativeTargetName = "Windows\\System32\\config\\SAM" OR RelativeTargetName = "Windows\\System32\\config\\SECURITY" OR RelativeTargetName = "Windows\\System32\\config\\SYSTEM")))
